prompt:
ONE image provided, two side-by-side columns of EQUAL size, output at 5:4, 2400x1920px geometry. LEFT column: a plain neutral grey PANEL on a light backdrop containing exactly 8 small abstract flat-colour REGIONS of different shapes and sizes (circles, an oval, rounded rectangles, a diamond) -- purely geometric shapes, not icons, not letters, not any recognizable object. RIGHT column: on a pure BLACK background, a vertical stack of exactly 8 EQUAL-HEIGHT horizontal CELLS separated by thin grey divider lines, numbered here only for your reference as cell 1 (topmost) through cell 8 (bottommost), reading top to bottom. All 8 cells are currently EMPTY (pure black).
ASSIGNMENT RULE -- NUMBER TAGS: each region on the LEFT panel carries a small printed number tag (1..8) on top of it, and each cell in the RIGHT column carries the matching printed number tag near its left edge. A region is ASSIGNED to the cell that carries the SAME number as the region's own tag (region tagged '3' -> cell tagged '3').
YOUR TASK: for every cell, identify which region on the LEFT panel is ASSIGNED to it (rule below), then paint INSIDE that cell ONLY a single SOLID WHITE FILLED silhouette that matches that region's exact shape and size (same shape family, same proportions), centered in the cell, leaving generous black margin around it. Do this for all 8 cells -- one silhouette per cell, matching all 8 regions. Do not resize, rotate, or distort the shape; do not merge, skip, or duplicate any region. Every silhouette must be plain solid WHITE on black, regardless of the source region's own colour -- the mask column encodes SHAPE and CELL ASSIGNMENT only, never colour.
Do not alter the LEFT panel's regions in any way (same shapes, same positions, same neutral fill). ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS anywhere in either column.
The number tags in BOTH columns are drafting/reference marks ONLY -- like masking tape with a grease-pencil number, used purely so you can match region to cell -- and MUST NOT appear in your finished output. Your output must contain ZERO printed numbers, digits, or tags anywhere, on the panel OR in the mask cells: paint the panel exactly as given but with its number tags removed/absent, and paint each mask cell's silhouette with NO number tag surviving in it.
